correctness.rationale: In exact first-order coordinates (x,v,a), H=a²/2+xv-∫_0^v f has Lie derivative v²-Aa², with no approximation or differentiability of f beyond local Lipschitz required (F is C1). Compactly supported invariant measures annihilate generator observables x,x²/2,v²/2,va,H, yielding both balances; zero v² forces support at e. A<=0 gives monotone H and LaSalle on bounded orbits; alpha/omega limit sets both equal e on a bounded complete orbit, forcing H constant and orbit stationary. For periodic v, mean zero and exact Wirtinger yield P>=2pi√A; pure harmonic equality requires f(s)=f(0)-s/A throughout [-R,R], and its explicit orbit substitutes exactly. For f(v)=v², E[v²(v+1/A)]=0 plus E v=0 gives strict negative/positive excursions. Independent symbolic Lie identities and equality orbit verified; symbolic tests cannot replace the compact-invariance/Wirtinger proof.
